# Wordpress-to-csv

## Purpose and structure
This folder contains the **Wordpress-to-csv** workflow. Its executable nodes use `manualTrigger`, `spreadsheetFile`, `wordpress`, `writeBinaryFile`. The table and connection map below are derived from the JSON, not an inferred guarantee of behavior.

## Setup
Import inactive. Configure your own credentials and replace REPLACE_WITH_* values. Review external destinations and Code nodes before running.

## Entry points
On clicking 'execute'

## Verification
Sanitized source candidate; not runtime-tested. This overview is generated from node metadata. Read the folder README for the connection map, credential types, and license.
